evidence_class: Mocked in CI: rendered Pod manifests checked without a cluster, a cache store whose read only mount is simulated through the store's mount probe, and a local artifact directory replaced by a file to model lost shared storage. No NFS, no Pod and no live rollout proof.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.kubernetes.storage.MountChecker().check(pod): refuses shared_runtime, unscoped_shared_write and operator_home with StorageRefused(message, reason); shared_runtime_mount_rejections_total() counts every reason
python -m scripts.swarm_v2.kubernetes.storage <pod.json>: exit 0 when the Pod passes, 1 with the refusal, an unreadable file or a non Pod document on stderr, 64 on usage errors
Pod policy mounts (docs/swarm-v2/schemas/pod-policy.json): seed, artifact and cache with a claim, host_path or nfs source; load_policy refuses repeated names or normalised paths

scripts.swarm_v2.kubernetes.spec.PodTemplate.render: seed and cache render read only, artifact renders writable with subPath set to the execution id; a Pod failing the checker is refused with reason storage; shared_runtime_mount_rejections_total() on the template
scripts.swarm_v2.cache.Store.read_only (default mounted_read_only, the statvfs read only flag of the nearest existing folder): attach on a read only store writes nothing, publish from it is refused

scripts.swarm_v2.artifacts.publication.publish(store, scope, artifact_id, source) -> Publication(published|paused, ref, reason): an OSError from the artifact backend pauses publication and leaves the attempt files untouched

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.kubernetes: Pod v1 volume and volumeMount fields: persistentVolumeClaim, nfs and hostPath sources, readOnly, subPath; subPathExpr is not accepted as scope
supported_versions.filesystem: POSIX statvfs ST_RDONLY on the ubuntu CI runner

states.observed: Rendered Pod manifests, store trees before and after attach and publish, attempt worktree snapshots before and after a lost backend
states.accepted: A Pod that passes MountChecker; a seed read from a read only store; a paused publication that left the worktree unchanged
states.committed: An artifact put through the artifact store after the backend returns, once, with the same reference on replay
states.externally_verified: None; no cluster, NFS export or node cache owner uses the package yet

red: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38073494779 on 38997c46: tests only commit, ModuleNotFoundError for scripts.swarm_v2.kubernetes.storage and scripts.swarm_v2.artifacts.publication
validation.green: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38075950364 on 6a13b96fa4e52183965b2af1d213ac5822dd0944: every unit shard on 3.11 and 3.12, test-count and the mutation shards passed; sonar failed only on one unreviewed python:S5443 hotspot, reviewed SAFE afterwards
validation.mutation: Branch preflight on every pushed head; 27 survivors on d0ba29e3 killed by 32f17171 and 478b8965; the PR mutation shard survivor in normal killed by 4430c6c7
validation.review: Spec reader closed with no findings; Standards reader ran three rounds and closed, its last two held items fixed or documented in b39ccb42
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; lint, format and size passed in the pre push gate on every head

a.condition: a safe deployment passes, then the same Pod with a shared writable Codex home is refused, on two independent fixtures

b.condition: a pod policy mounting the operator home into every worker is refused by the template, the policy is unchanged and no host path is disclosed

c.condition: lost artifact storage pauses publication; no mount is checked

acceptance.T-SV2-FSY-05-A: tests.contracts.storage_layout.cases.case_a, asserted by test_package_cases_pass_on_the_isolated_fixture in the green run
acceptance.T-SV2-FSY-05-B: tests.contracts.storage_layout.cases.case_b, including the node cache seed write refused with the store tree unchanged
acceptance.T-SV2-FSY-05-C: tests.contracts.storage_layout.cases.case_c: paused on loss, worktree intact, one commit after restore, identical replay

case_outputs: a-result.json, b-result.json and c-result.json are not committed: evidence/SV2-FSY-05/generate_case_results.py executes the case code, and test code runs only in CI on this fleet. The case results are asserted in the green run above.
rollback: Return to private local execution with artifact publishing paused until the backend is healthy: render Pods without policy mounts and leave committed artifact objects in place. Not rehearsed on a live cluster.
remaining_limitations: The cloud to on-prem artifact throughput and WAN failure benchmark is a live rollout gate measurement and has not been taken
The node cache owner process that publishes seeds into the read only store is named in docs/swarm-v2/storage-policy.md, not built
Eviction on a store that attempts only read falls back to publish order
The checker is lexical; a node host path that is a symlink into a home passes, node layout and policy authors are trusted
